archive.catalogue_description: Description Info: This is my 1st completed map out of the 4-6 maps I have started. It takes place in the near future in a bunker. Will you live to see the end of the Zombie Apocalypse?! Notice: To play map solo, enable console and type “devmap nazi_zombie_Bunkerr”. I apologize that there is no option that you can click to play the map automatically. Features: -Custom Scripting -Mystery Box -All four Perks -P-A-P -Risers -No Dogs -Buyable Ending -Increased zombie spawn rates -increased Power ups drops Contact Information: Skype-TheGlitchCrib Steam-ZombiesEd Youtube- http://www.youtube.com/user/ZombiesEd http://www.youtube.com/user/i2eboot As of right now there are no known glitches. The only Bug is the zombies will start spawning a tad bit before the round begins ballbuster1

notes: Replaces common scripts (maps/_callbackglobal.gsc, maps/_gameskill.gsc, maps/_laststand.gsc, maps/_load.gsc, maps/_loadout.gsc); re-verify the generic down/revive/score events on it. Ships 2 executable(s): $PLUGINSDIR/System.dll, $PLUGINSDIR/nsDialogs.dll. NEVER RUN THEM (dev-box.md rule 3).
